What sets the lower bound

  1. YES bid on “Will the Fed increase interest rates by 25 bps after the December 2026 meeting?”, for “The Fed raises by a quarter point on December 9”: 91.0%
  2. YES bid on “Will the Federal Reserve Hike rates by >25bps at their December 2026 meeting?”, for “The Fed raises by a half point or more on December 9”: 6.0%
  3. “The Fed raises by a half point or more on December 9” is one way “The Fed raises rates at its December 9 meeting” can turn out
  4. “The Fed raises by a quarter point on December 9” is one way “The Fed raises rates at its December 9 meeting” can turn out

What sets the upper bound

  1. NO ask on “Will the Federal Reserve Hike rates by 0bps at their December 2026 meeting?”, for “The Fed raises rates at its December 9 meeting”: 97.0%
